description: Every Hostex v3 operation, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-property questions no single Hostex call can — occupancy gaps, revenue rollups, and guest-message SLA, offline.

novel_features.name: Operations gap finder
novel_features.description: Find imminent or occupied stays with no cleaning task or missing check-in details.

novel_features.name: Stay brief dossier
novel_features.description: One dossier for a single stay: reservation, guest, thread state, tasks, transactions, and review.

novel_features.name: Inbox SLA triage
novel_features.description: Rank open guest conversations by age since the last guest message and flag threads past your SLA.

novel_features.name: Automation preview
novel_features.description: List pending automated messages and reviews and flag any whose thread a human has already handled.

novel_features.name: Cross-channel price parity
novel_features.description: Flag property-dates where per-channel listing price or min-stay diverges across channels.

novel_features.name: Oversell / double-sell watch
novel_features.description: Flag dates a channel still shows bookable on a property that is blocked or booked on the master calendar.

novel_features.name: Revenue rollup
novel_features.description: Net income minus expense by property or month over a date range, from the live ledger.
